Ground and air Drink callers invoke this entry before selecting the copy kind and passing it to copy processing; this function itself does not grant an ability.

evidence.why: Installation, variant-dependent exit and complete unclamped formula.

facts.rationale: Replaces unconditional regrowth and sampled-endpoint assertions with exact arithmetic and local scheduling constraints.
facts.value: Installed as accessory4_cb by shared ThrownKirby entry. Each invocation computes f=(x10-grab_timer)/x10, multiplies f by xC, and writes ((1-xC)-(-f)) times each saved scale component to the root JObj. It performs no clamp, finite-value check, zero-duration guard, transition, or callback removal. Mathematical reduced/saved endpoints require suitable finite inputs and corresponding timer samples; monotonic enlargement and endpoint invocation are not guaranteed. Ordinary recovery exits on a nonpositive timer, while copy recovery exits on its next physics invocation regardless of timer.

Only XY are changed; no normalization.
Recovery velocity setup occurs inside entry before it returns.

facts.rationale: Corrects horizontal-plane wording, separates contact reflection from guarded recovery, and preserves operation ordering.
facts.value: Selects a stage-contact normal and, when any component is nonzero, modifies the victim's XY velocity through lbVector_Mirror. Only a strictly negative old/new XY velocity dot product triggers shared ThrownKirby recovery; afterward x8 is assigned -1 for negative normal.x and +1 otherwise. The vector utility leaves Z unchanged and does not normalize the supplied normal. This post-entry x8 assignment cannot influence velocity setup already completed by the same entry call.

evidence.why: Complete shared motion helper and physics callback.

facts.rationale: Records exact branches, canonical expressions and numerical boundaries instead of inferred uniform deceleration.
facts.value: Let m=sqrt(self_vel.x²+self_vel.y²). When m>mv.co.thrownkirby.x4, X becomes X*(m-thrownkirby.x4)/m and Y becomes Y*(m-mv.ca.specialhi.vel.x)/m; facing is then -1 for resulting Y<0 and +1 otherwise. Otherwise only X is cleared; Y and facing are unchanged. Z is untouched. Timer subtraction by ftKb_SpecialN_800F5AC0 always occurs, followed by GrabMash, x14 storage and recovery entry on grab_timer<=0. Equality takes the X-only fallback. No finite-value checks exist; NaN does not satisfy the release comparison. Compiled equivalence of the two union expressions and invariant speed reduction remain unresolved.
